sed -i 's/button(type="button" aria-pressed={isFavorite ? .true. : .false.} onClick={toggle})/button(type="button" onClick={toggle})/' src/components/favorite-button.kay
cat > src/routes/contact.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { t } from 'kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import ContactForm from '../components/contact-form.kay'

const contactInput = t.Object({
  name: t.String({ maxLength: 200 }),
  email: t.String({ maxLength: 320 }),
  message: t.String({ maxLength: 5000 }),
})

export const send = action(contactInput, (input, ctx) => {
  const errors = checkContact(input)

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0)
    return ctx.fail(422, { errors })

  return { name: input.name.trim() }
})
---
head
  title Contact
h1 Contact
ContactForm
EOF
cat > src/components/contact-form.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'
import { checkContact } from '../contact'
import type { ContactErrors } from '../contact'

const errors = signal<ContactErrors>(send.failed()?.data?.errors ?? {})
const thanked = signal(send.succeeded()?.data.name ?? '')

async function submit(event: SubmitEvent) {
  event.preventDefault()
  const form = event.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement
  const fields = new FormData(form)
  const found = checkContact({
    name: String(fields.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(fields.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(fields.get('message') ?? ''),
  })

  errors.set(found)
  thanked.set('')

  if (Object.keys(found).length === 0) {
    thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
  }
}
---
if thanked
  p.success(role="status") Thanks, {thanked}! Your message has been sent.
form(action={send} novalidate onSubmit={submit})
  .field
    label(for="name") Name
    input#name(type="text" name="name")
    if errors.name
      p.error {errors.name}
  .field
    label(for="email") Email
    input#email(type="email" name="email")
    if errors.email
      p.error {errors.email}
  .field
    label(for="message") Message
    textarea#message(name="message")
    if errors.message
      p.error {errors.message}
  button(type="submit") Send
EOF
bun run check
grep -rn "ActionError" docs/llms/*.md | grep -i import | head -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20
bun run build 2>&1 | head -12; grep -o "ActionError" node_modules/kay/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/kay; grep -n '"\.\|exports' node_modules/kay/package.json | head -20

cd src/components && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'\n","import { ActionError } from 'kay'\nimport { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'\n")
s=s.replace("""    thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
""","""    try {
      thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
      form.reset()
    }
    catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
        throw error
      const data = error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined
      errors.set(data?.errors ?? {})
    }
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
